obligations.ask: Attend the appointment about your water account

results.segment: Your appointment about your water account with Northgate Water is booked for 26 June 2026 at 9.10am.

Please bring a recent proof of your address with you on the day.
Please come to the desk marked Appointments.
Please order a replacement card before your appointment so that you have it with you.
If the date no longer suits you, our reception team can offer another.
Your account has been in credit by £31.75 since 5 February.
